description: A refused key set leaves the accepted key set in place, and envelopes still verify against it.

input.scenario: Trust anchor root-1. Accepted key set version 3 with online-1. Deliver key set version 4 signed only by root-2, then envelope 42 signed by online-1.

expect.behaviour: Key set 4 is refused with signature_invalid, the accepted key set stays version 3 with its digest, and envelope 42 is accepted.
